replacements.label: tab2
replacements.original:
\begin{table}[h]
\caption{CEPS within and between class associations}\label{tab2}
\footnotesize
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
%
\begin{tabular*}{\textwidth}{@{\extracolsep\fill}llll@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Domain and estimand} & \textbf{Estimate} & \textbf{95\% lower} & \textbf{95\% upper}\\
\midrule
\shortstack[l]{Classmates and class atmosphere\\ Within class $\beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & -0.120 & -0.145 & -0.095\\
\shortstack[l]{Classmates and class atmosphere\\ Between class $\beta_{\mathrm{B}}$} & -0.096 & -0.284 & 0.091\\
\shortstack[l]{Classmates and class atmosphere\\ Contextual $\beta_{\mathrm{B}} - \beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & 0.024 & -0.159 & 0.207\\
\shortstack[l]{School belonging aggregated within classes\\ Within class $\beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & -0.094 & -0.113 & -0.075\\
\shortstack[l]{School belonging aggregated within classes\\ Between class $\beta_{\mathrm{B}}$} & -0.183 & -0.349 & -0.018\\
\shortstack[l]{School belonging aggregated within classes\\ Contextual $\beta_{\mathrm{B}} - \beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & -0.090 & -0.259 & 0.080\\
\shortstack[l]{Class items only model\\ Within class $\beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & -0.180 & -0.203 & -0.156\\
\shortstack[l]{Class items only model\\ Between class $\beta_{\mathrm{B}}$} & -0.243 & -0.368 & -0.117\\
\shortstack[l]{Class items only model\\ Contextual $\beta_{\mathrm{B}} - \beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & -0.063 & -0.184 & 0.058\\
\botrule
\end{tabular*}
\footnotetext{The first six rows are from the primary joint weighted model with 17991 students, 438 classes and 112 schools; each domain conditions on the other's two terms. The last three rows omit school belonging while retaining the same students and other covariates. All models include school fixed effects. Estimates are negative affect points (1 to 5) per one domain point (1 to 4). $\beta_{\mathrm{B}}$ is a between class association within school; $\beta_{\mathrm{B}} - \beta_{\mathrm{W}}$ uses the two coefficients and their covariance in the same model. Intervals use school clustered covariance and t(111). The two domains differ in content and referent, so their comparison cannot isolate a wording effect.}
\end{table}

replacements.original:
\begin{table}[h]
\caption{CEPS contextual association sensitivities}\label{tab3}
\footnotesize
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}
%
\begin{tabular*}{\textwidth}{@{\extracolsep\fill}lllll@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Specification} & \textbf{Students} & \textbf{Classes} & \textbf{$\beta_{\mathrm{B}} - \beta_{\mathrm{W}}$} & \textbf{95\% CI}\\
\midrule
Primary joint model & 17991 & 438 & 0.024 & -0.159 to 0.207\\
Class clustered intervals & 17991 & 438 & 0.024 & -0.140 to 0.188\\
Unweighted & 17991 & 438 & 0.047 & -0.095 to 0.189\\
No school fixed effects & 17991 & 438 & 0.021 & -0.120 to 0.161\\
Class items only & 17991 & 438 & -0.063 & -0.184 to 0.058\\
At least 10 reporters & 17982 & 437 & 0.026 & -0.156 to 0.209\\
At least 20 reporters & 17835 & 427 & 0.027 & -0.157 to 0.211\\
At least 30 reporters & 16578 & 373 & -0.011 & -0.203 to 0.182\\
At least one class item & 18107 & 438 & 0.019 & -0.166 to 0.204\\
At least four affect items & 18173 & 438 & 0.026 & -0.156 to 0.208\\
Lower reporter count stratum & 4521 & 159 & 0.095 & -0.446 to 0.635\\
Middle reporter count stratum & 8771 & 200 & -0.120 & -0.474 to 0.234\\
Upper reporter count stratum & 4699 & 79 & 0.018 & -0.529 to 0.565\\
Classmates treatment item & 17991 & 438 & 0.088 & -0.087 to 0.262\\
Class atmosphere item & 17991 & 438 & -0.016 & -0.137 to 0.105\\
Ordinal controls as factors & 17991 & 438 & 0.015 & -0.166 to 0.197\\
\botrule
\end{tabular*}
\footnotetext{Units are negative affect points per one perception point. Joint domain adjustment is used unless designated class items only. Intervals use school clustered finite sample t inference, except the class clustered row. Reporter thresholds apply to both aggregate pools. Stratum cut points 39 and 54 are percentiles of reporter counts repeated over analytic student records, not enrollment quartiles. Strata are exploratory, with no formal moderation test. The no school fixed effect model includes school differences. Separate item and ordinal-factor sensitivities retain the primary sample and reporter pool; each item is fitted in its own joint model. Full components appear in Table S3f.}
\end{table}
